newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daewoo Motor April sales up 13.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daewoo Motor April sales up 13.7 pct.

text.p: Daewoo Motor Co Ltd, an unlisted unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Friday its vehicles sales in April rose 13.7 percent to 69,988 units from 61.561 a year earlier.
Exports totalled 27,637 units in the month, down 17.8 percent from 33,615 a year ago, while domestic sales amounted to 42,351 units against 27,946.
A Daewoo spokesman said the rise in domestic sales was due to the successful debut of new model cars, including Leganza mid-sized sedans, which sold 14,151 units in April.
Sales of Nubira compact cars, which began selling in February, totalled 13,072 units in April and the smaller Lanos cars, rolled out last November, amounted to 5,160.
He said exports were affected by some shipping problems, but refused to elaborate.
